tasks.label: Verificar estados y FK de pedidos
tasks.command: Set-Location backend; Remove-Item Env:DATABASE_PASSWORD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; & 'C:\Users\respinozav\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python313\python.exe' -c "from sqlalchemy import text; from app.core.database import engine; connection = engine.connect(); states = connection.execute(text('SELECT nombre FROM estados ORDER BY nombre')).scalars().all(); nullable = connection.execute(text(\"SELECT is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'pedidos' AND column_name = 'estado_id'\")).scalar_one(); foreign_key = connection.execute(text(\"SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'pedidos' AND constraint_name = 'fk_pedidos_estado_id' AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'\")).scalar_one(); print('estados=' + ','.join(states)); print('estado_id_nullable=' + nullable); print('estado_id_fk=' + str(foreign_key == 1)); connection.close()"

tasks.label: Verificar estados y FK de pedidos (corregido)
